runner: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free via the opencode agent
notes: Vanilla canvas 2D. Dusk highway with layered parallax: painted sky, clouds, two mountain ridges, treeline, poles and sagging wires, roadside trees, guardrail, grass, tarmac with scrolling aggregate, and an out-of-focus foreground strip. Fastback coupe built from one silhouette path, wheels rotate with distance travelled, and the body heaves and pitches on a road profile. Seeded deterministic layers wrap on exact spans for a seamless loop. Verified in Chromium: no console errors.
